text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One lunch break, I spot a dressed-up El Condor Pasa striking powerful poses.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hwa-taaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! I've got my outfit on, so I'm in a good mood!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Doin' this really makes me feel better! A-cha!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oooh! What's this?! That outfit… Are you a hero?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A h-hero?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No, this is just my Condor Monk outfit! I'm no hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So… it's a villain costume?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Are you talking about limpios and rudos or something? If that's what you mean, then I want to be un limpio de la justicia!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Although… a rudo villain is just as important for livening up the show.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh! You totally get it! A good hero needs a good villain!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! It's the passion from both good and evil that makes for an incredible battle!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's right, that's right! Do you have a special technique?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course! I learned a lot of aerial techniques from my papa, plus the ones I came up with on my own!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Aerial attacks! That's so cool! What kind of villains do you fight? And who's your partner?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wow, you're really into this…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It seems like you're quite a fan! Don't worry, I'll return your passion tenfold!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, how can I best convey my passion?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Yes! If you don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Has the villain made an appearance?! Or a second hero perhaps?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nope! Actually, my trainer here's gonna tell you just how passionate I am!
choice_data_list: She's just as passionate as her outfit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nope! Actually, my trainer here's gonna tell you just how passionate I am!
choice_data_list: She's just as passionate as her outfit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Er… So what should I do?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho! Let's show off my blazing dance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ha! Did you see that?! The ultimate technique of the Condor Style!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So that's the Condor monk secret technique?! That was so flippin' cool!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You bet! But surely your praise doesn't end there! Tell me more, haha!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! This has been so much fun! It's been so long since I've seen such passionate techniques!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's talk again soon!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Gladly! Anytime!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like El Condor Pasa was able to convey her passion to Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since then, Biko Pegasus has started to send El Condor Pasa frequent invites to see various plays and programs regarding heroes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You mean like… a fiery robot?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I don't have a robot!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh?! So you have a secondary form?! A fiery one!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I feel like we're talking about two completely different things…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But! I understand your passion! And I have to match it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! Of course! What're a few misconceptions in the face of such passion? I can't sweat the small stuff!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I don't really get it, but what you just said was so coooool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bing-bong, bing-bong!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah… lunch break is over already?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It was so much fun talking about heroes! Let's talk again soon! See ya!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Biko has a completely different kind of passion than I do.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I can't lose to her, though!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa seems to have a reignited sense of determination from her talk with Biko Pegasus.
